description: Open, edit and save Word and Excel files (docx, xlsx, doc, xls, RTF) in the browser. A document and spreadsheet engine in TypeScript with no server and no runtime dependencies; one script from a CDN or the bymoffice npm package. Also runs in WebViews (Flutter, Android, iOS) through a bridge page.
rules: BymOffice.mount(element, { file }) returns a Promise; it rejects (it does not throw) for an unsupported file, an invalid option or a cancelled password.
With a bundler or ES modules, copy the package's dist/fonts/ folder into the build output and pass its address as fontsUrl. The CDN script finds its fonts by itself.
doc, xls and RTF open read-only. Pass convert: true to edit them; they are then saved as docx or xlsx.
To save back to the address the file was fetched from, use saveTo (PUT with If-Match/ETag; see docs/server.md). Without saveTo, onSave receives the bytes on Ctrl/Cmd+S.
Call destroy() on the mounted editor when its element is removed, for example in a React effect cleanup or Vue onBeforeUnmount.
